title: Augment the Cache, Replace the Activation: A 2x2 Study of Internal-State Sharing
abstract: arXiv:2610.22026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent systems built from frozen language models communicate through text, which discards the internal state the sender already computed and makes the receiver pay to rebuild it. Work on internal channels avoids that cost, framing the problem as transfer: agent A sends information to agent B. Every agent pair that must communicate needs its own transfer bridge, and every agent added to a system needs a new bridge fitted against each previous agent. We reframe this problem as sharing: an agent publishes its internal state once into a pool, and every peer reads that pool through a single mechanism fitted to no sender in particular, so adding an agent adds a publisher and no new bridge. Whereas the carrier of the internal state and the fusion mechanism are usually chosen independently in the literature, our main finding is that these two choices are coupled; the deciding factor is where the carrier enters the receiver's computation. translated_title: 增强缓存，替换激活：内部状态共享的2×2研究
translated_abstract: 由冻结语言模型构建的多智能体系统通过文本进行通信，这会丢弃发送方已经计算好的内部状态，并使接收方付出代价去重建它。关于内部信道的研究避免了这一成本，但将问题设定为传输：智能体A向智能体B发送信息。每一对需要通信的智能体都需要自己的传输桥梁，而系统中每增加一个智能体，都需要针对之前的每个智能体重新拟合新的桥梁。我们将这一问题重新设定为共享：智能体将其内部状态一次性发布到共享池中，每个对等体通过单一的机制读取该池，该机制不针对任何特定发送方拟合，因此增加一个智能体只需增加一个发布者，而无需新的桥梁。与文献中通常独立选择内部状态载体和融合机制的做法不同，我们的主要发现是这两个选择是相互耦合的，决定性因素在于载体进入接收方计算的位置。
tldr: 本文将多智能体系统中的内部状态“传输”范式重构为“共享”范式，并发现内部状态载体与融合机制的选择是相互耦合的，其关键在于载体进入接收方计算的位置。
en_tdlr: This paper reframes internal-state transfer among multi-agent systems as sharing, and reveals that the choices of internal-state carrier and fusion mechanism are coupled, with the deciding factor being where the carrier enters the receiver's computation.
